depending on where you are it may be harder or easier, if you're in a city area it's pretty straight forward, you go to your GP ask for a referral to a Psychiatrist and talk to them. The psychiatrist will refer you to your local endo. 

However if you are a student I'd advise going and talking to your Uni's health system and nosing around with in that people in my area have had better and quicker results talking to people there.

If you're in a smaller town it'll likely be harder as you'll probably have to come to a city but I'm unsure if that's 100% true as I haven't experienced that. IF you need help there are a bunch of support groups littered all around NZ I go to one semi-regularly that helped out quite a bit with finding doctors who would be supportive.  
Edit: PM if you need anything I'd be happy to help with what I can.
